name: wow.command.duration
description: A command's execution by the kernel, from taking it to its outcome.

name: wow.command.refusals
description: The commands that ended before the kernel took them: admission refusals, busy lanes or nodes, a closing node, an unavailable store, a wait that timed out while the command queued; by problem code.

name: wow.command.rejections
description: The commands their aggregate's decision rejected, a business outcome rather than a failure, with or without events; by the rejection's code.

name: wow.command.forward.failures
description: The forwards that got no settlement from the partition's owner.

name: wow.wait.timeouts
description: The waits that timed out, by the last stage they reached.

name: wow.wait.signal.drops
description: The wait signals for another node dropped unsent.

name: wow.executor.in_flight
description: The commands in a context's executor, waiting in their lanes or in the kernel.

name: wow.executor.lanes
description: The aggregates of a context with commands in flight.

name: wow.log.append_queue.depth
description: The appends queued on a context's partition append queue.

name: wow.log.tail.reads
description: The reads of the store a tail of a context's log made because the node's own commits, handed over in memory, could not continue it.

name: wow.state_cache.lookups
description: The kernel's lookups of a state in a context's state cache.

name: wow.state_cache.evictions
description: The states evicted from a context's state cache.

name: wow.store.fallbacks
description: The times a store fell back from an optional capability and did the work the way every store can. A failed one is a store that failed where it should not: look at the warning it logged first.

name: wow.reservation.losses
description: The keys committed facts lost to another owner after their pending reservations expired. Each breaks the uniqueness its fact reserved for: alert on it.

name: wow.subscription.lag
description: From a stream's commit to a subscription handling it.

name: wow.subscription.position
description: A subscription's watermark in a partition of the log.

name: wow.subscription.backlog
description: The entries of a partition of the log after a subscription's watermark.

name: wow.subscription.progress
description: How far a subscription has come in a partition of the log, its watermark over the log's head, from 0 to 1: a rebuild's progress.

name: wow.subscription.parked.aggregates
description: The entries a subscription has parked.

name: wow.subscription.parked.notices
description: The entries parked, and those whose automatic retries are spent.

name: wow.subscription.paused.partitions
description: The partitions a subscription has paused on a systemic failure on this node, 0 while it runs them all.

name: wow.subscription.paused.notices
description: The partitions a subscription paused on a systemic failure, and resumed.

name: wow.subscription.throttled.partitions
description: The partitions a subscription throttles on backpressure on this node, running fewer handlings at once than its in-flight bound, 0 while it runs them all at full speed.

name: wow.subscription.throttled.notices
description: The partitions a subscription started throttling on backpressure, and stopped.

name: wow.subscription.backpressure.refusals
description: The attempts of a subscription whose downstream pushed back, each retried with backoff; by the downstream's problem code, or the failure's class.

name: wow.subscription.undecodable.messages
description: The messages of a topic this version cannot decode: parked when its key names an aggregate, else skipped.

name: wow.kafka.offset.gaps
description: The offsets a read of another context's topic was to start from that its partition no longer holds.

name: wow.timer.delay
description: How late a timer fires after its due time.

name: wow.query.duration
description: A query of an aggregate type's snapshots or events, from its admission to its end.

name: wow.query.dataset.duration
description: A query of a dataset, from its admission to its end.

name: wow.query.events.pinned
description: The aggregates events queries named and a pinned query policy had checked, by how they were read: by one snapshot query, or one by one.

name: wow.query.limit.current
description: How many queries a store runs at once now, its query bulkhead's limit.

name: wow.query.pressure
description: Whether a store's writes pressed in the last period, 1 or 0.

name: wow.query.limit.decreases
description: How many times a store's query limit was halved for its writes.
